name: Music - BM - Percussion Emphasis
narrative:
MAJOR REGULATIONS
PREREQUISITES Check the General Catalog for the prerequisites to all listed courses.
P/NP GRADING OPTION Up to 8 units of UD CCS music courses may be taken P/NP. All other major units, including those applied to the major from other departments, must be taken for letter grades.
SUBSTITUTIONS In the major requirements permissible only by petition to the department chair and dean.
G.P.A REQUIREMENTS At least 2.0 overall UC average in all upper-division major courses and all courses (Prep and UD) for the major.
DOUBLE MAJORS With the approval of each department chairperson, up to a total of 8 units may be applied simultaneously to both UD majors.

requirement.label: At least 71 UD Music units are required, distributed as follows
requirement.notes:
- Up to 8 units of upper-division electives (Area H) may be taken in music courses at the College of Creative Studies.
- All auditions, including recital auditions, must be reviewed by the Woodwinds/Brass/Percussion Committee and approved by at least two members of the committee. Junior and senior recitals may not be given until the appropriate recital audition has been approved.
- All students enrolled in applied instruction in an orchestral instrument are required to elect orchestra (Mus A42/A142) or wind ensemble (Mus A34/A134), if their participation is needed.
